name: vehicle speed
definition_status: Beauvais Vu=constrained carriage speed ft/s; distinct from total V

name: crosswind speed
definition_status: Beauvais Vv=perpendicular tunnel crossflow ft/s; no longitudinal wind term

name: relative-wind yaw angle
definition_status: Beauvais psi=atan(Vv/Vu), deg nose-right convention; Hucho beta=aerodynamic yaw; symbol names not transferable; Lewington PDF7Fig10 beta is aerodynamic incidence;PDF8 Eq5 beta is vehicle sideslip;local symbols must be disambiguated;Oct19 analyst planar alpha=atan2(vehicle-through-air y,x) only with declared axes/wind direction;not automatically source sign;zero relative velocity undefined;Volpe2013 beta=atan(v+/u+) in positive-u empty-facility flow;not vehicle heading/sideslip;probe position must accompany input

name: vehicle heading angle
definition_status: Hucho p899 psi=vehicle yaw in deg; not aerodynamic beta; Nakasato Fig15 yaw=body heading relative target path, not aerodynamic incidence;Oct19 analyst heading is body attitude relative ground axis;not velocity course;defined independently of zero ground speed

name: vehicle sideslip angle
definition_status: velocity_reference_pending; Lewington PDF8 Eq5 beta_vehicle=int(a_y/v_x-r);initial/frame details pending;distinct from Fig10 aerodynamic beta;Oct19 analyst beta_v=atan2(same-point ground-velocity body y,x);undefined at zero ground speed;source sensor/reference point still must be verified

name: aerodynamic side force
definition_status: Macklin1996: CFY=Y/(0.5rhoU^2A), A frontal; positive yaw gives positive Y; source mirror-MIRA axes; Ryan1998 CY uses axialv and zero-yaw frontalA, not resultantU
